svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 防微杜渐 (traditional 防微杜漸), fáng wēi dù jiàn, “Stop the small before it spreads”. A lint rule today beats a refactor next year. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.

g.text: A lint rule today beats a refactor next year.
